articles.summary: Logistics Viewpoints explores Descartes' latest advances in agentic AI, including the introduction of the Descartes Agent Control Plane at its 2026 Innovation Forum. Built on the Descartes Global Logistics Network (GLN), the Agent Control Plane is designed to coordinate AI agents across applications and trading partners, helping automate multi-step logistics workflows while maintaining customer-defined controls and human oversight.
articles.title: Logistics Viewpoints: Descartes Takes Agentic AI Into the Logistics Workflow at the Descartes Innovation Forum

articles.summary: Reuters highlights the latest Descartes Global Shipping Report, which found that U.S. ocean container imports reached a new record for September. The findings underscore the continued strength of U.S. import activity despite ongoing tariff and geopolitical volatility, reinforcing the importance of supply chain visibility, risk management and informed planning as businesses navigate shifting global trade conditions.
articles.title: Reuters: US ocean container imports set new record for September, Descartes says

articles.summary: In a new Forbes Technology Council article, Descartes CEO Ed Ryan explores why growing regulatory scrutiny is making supply chain governance a leadership priority. From trade compliance and sanctions enforcement to carrier safety and fraud prevention, Ed explains how trusted data, technology and auditable processes help businesses strengthen oversight across trading partners, reduce risk and turn accountability into a competitive advantage.
articles.title: Forbes Technology Council: Supply Chain Accountability: A Growing Leadership Issue

articles.title: Fall Sales Put Inventory Planning in Focus for Ecommerce Sellers

articles.summary: CHICAGO, Illinois and LONDON, UK, October 6, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Descartes Systems Group (Nasdaq:DSGX) (TSX:DSG), the global leader in uniting logistics-intensive businesses in commerce, introduced the Descartes Agent Control Plane at its Innovation Forum in Chicago, which this year brings together a record number of customers, speakers and sponsors to explore innovation in supply chain and logistics technology. Built on the Descartes Global Logistics Network™ (Descartes GLN™), the Agent Control Plane is designed to build trust in AI agents by coordinating them across applications and trading partners to execute multi-step workflows within defined guardrails, policies and human oversight.
articles.title: Descartes Unveils Next Step in Supply Chain AI with Agent Control Plane
